entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order here for the AeroGrip cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
They're just not right. I've been riding for years, I know how to set up cleats, but these shoes gave me terrible blisters on a short ride. I want a refund.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the worst. Let me check the delivery date... okay, I see they were delivered just last week.
Yes. So can I return them or not?
Absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Fine. I guess that's one thing that's easy.

I do apologize again that the cycling shoes didn't work out. I see you're one of our VIP members, Sam, and we really value your business. For the trouble, I'd like to add a free expedited shipping credit to your account for your next order.

Okay, that credit has been applied. The return label is on its way to your email. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can get you into a better-fitting pair of shoes soon. Have a good day.
